payload.body: You tend to question yourself right after doing something visible. You speak up, volunteer, dress the way you want, or take credit for your work, then replay every reaction and wonder whether you went too far. Underneath is often an old lesson that confidence made other people uncomfortable or that recognition had to be earned by being agreeable. Let one visible choice stand without explaining or reducing it afterward.
